test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "Poliseman."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'Policeman.'
 
• 'Policeman' means 'a male member of a police force.' (एक पुलिस बल का एक पुरुष सदस्य)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The **policeman** took the thief by the wrist.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Poliseman' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's know the meaning of the other options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Warden
 a person who is in charge of (the people in) a particular building. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष भवन का (लोगों में) प्रभारी होता है)
 
 

 Engineer
 a person whose job is to design or build machines, engines, or electrical equipment. (एक व्यक्ति जिसका काम मशीनों, इंजनों या बिजली के उपकरणों का डिजाइन या निर्माण करना है)
 
 

 Doctor
 a person with a medical degree whose job is to treat people who are ill or hurt. (एक मेडिकल डिग्री वाला व्यक्ति जिसका काम बीमार या चोटिल लोगों का इलाज करना है)
